notes.title: Version 3 Hotfix Update (Steam Only)
notes.content: A small update has been made to Eldritch Academy's v3 release. Changes to the way the script tracks story completion in v3 made the achievement "Director's Tenacity" difficult to unlock. This hotfix should make it possible to unlock this achievement in v3. In addition, the conditions for the achievement should now be checked in additional situations. (Previously, it only checked on game start. Now, it will also check upon reaching the end of the credits of most endings.)

notes.title: Eldritch Academy v3 Release
notes.content:
The long road to version 3 is over! With this update, Eldritch Academy can now be played with the new art, music, and script. Some highlights of the changes:

[list]
[*] Character and event art redrawn to match the style of Eldritch University
[*] Custom music in the same style as Eldritch University
[*] UI adapted from Eldritch University and a widescreen aspect ratio
[*] Improvements to the script, particularly in removing filler/duplicate scenes and making the choices feel more organic
[/list]
[i](More information on the changes can be found in some of the devlogs from during the process.)[/i]

Note that your save games from previous builds will NOT be compatible with the new version! (Not even the v3 beta's saves are safe.) The underlying code has changed too much to promise that old saves will load, so you will have to start a new game to see the changes. However, a lot of the persistent data (particularly ending completions) should carry over.

Still want to try the old versions? They will remain available for now, accessible in the following ways:

[list]
[*] Steam: Open the "Betas" tab and select the desired version. The game will then "update" to that version.
[*] itch.io: Download the ZIP or APK for the desired version and re-install.
[/list]
I hope that this update is fun for both new and returning players, so let me know what you think! And if there are any bugs, let me know and I'll look into patch fixes when I get the time. Thank you for supporting Eldritch Academy!

notes.title: Eldritch Academy v3 Beta Announcement
notes.content:
Last year, I announced that Eldritch Academy was getting a major update for Version 3. After a lot of on-and-off work, that update is nearing completion. In the meantime, I figured it was time to give a better look at the update while the last chunk is implemented. For that reason, I'm planning to make a beta branch for the game here on Steam once I've double-checked the common route for any major bugs or issues.

[h1]What's in the Version 3 Beta?[/h1]

The current plan is to have the full game be available in the beta, though some scenes will not have finalized art implementation and final script checks. In general, this is the breakdown:

[list]
[*] Prologue/Act 1/Act 2/Act 3: [b]Implemented[/b]
[*] Act 4/Epilogue: Art not implemented, script under review
[*] Aftermath stories (standalone): [b]Implemented[/b]
[*] Bonus Features: [b]Implemented[/b]
[/list]

If there are any major issues in the "implemented" scenes and features in the beta, bug reports would be very helpful in removing these issues from the final v3 build.

[h1]How do I access the beta?[/h1]

When the beta is uploaded, you will be able to switch to the beta by:
[list]
[*]Right-clicking on Eldritch Academy in your library and selecting Properties
[*]Navigate to the Betas tab
[*]Select the v3 beta branch and apply your selection
[/list]
After this, the game will replace the files from v2 with the v3 beta.

Once the final version is out, you may need to opt out of the beta build to download it. (Needs comfirmation.) This is the same process, but choosing to not opt into any beta builds.

[h1]When will this beta be available?[/h1]

I'd like to do some final checks on the existing content before uploading the beta, so I'd say the beta will be uploaded within the next week or so. I'll delay the beta if something major comes up, but otherwise I'd like to get it out there so people can pick up on any issues that escaped my notice.

I'll post an announcement on the Eldritch Academy page once the beta is available, so keep an eye out if you'd like to try the beta.

[h1]What's different about Version 3?[/h1]

Many of the changes can be found in the [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/eldritch-academy/devlog/200489/major-update-in-production]original announcement[/url]. A quick summary:
[list]
[*] Resolution, UI, and art changes
[*] New (custom) BGM tracks
[*] Common route script changes (particularly involving choices)
[*] Redundant scenes removed or combined
[/list]
For those who are more visual, I'll leave you with a few new screenshots of the game. I hope everyone looks forward to the update!

notes.title: Flowering Nightshade Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36329174/ba75973107620a8cd1581a963b79d0f42a2945fe.png[/img]

Flowering Nightshade (v7) is now available for download via Steam! Check out its store page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652030/

[i]Almost five years have passed since Himeka sought friendship and romance at Solana Academy. She and her friends have grown now, and have to face their adult responsibilities.

As a direct sequel to Blooming Nightshade, Flowering Nightshade continues the lighthearted romance story that began there. The player may choose to resume one of the six romantic storylines from Blooming Nightshade or begin a story featuring a new character.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 6 returning love interests, with stories focusing on the transition to adulthood and maintaining long-term relationships
[*] A new character and storyline
[*] Each story is longer and more focused than the story routes seen in Blooming Nightshade
[/list][/i]
I hope people enjoy this continuation of the story of Himeka and her friends in Akiramine!

notes.title: Eldritch Academy Update News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34519358/9c6c934abc1a5bb848752cc42c40027bfe70deea.png[/img]

A major update is in the works for Eldritch Academy! This version of the game will have redrawn art based on the style used for Eldritch University, custom music, and other tweaks to the presentation of the game. The highlights:

[list]
[*] Redrawn character and CG art for a widescreen aspect ratio, in the style of Eldritch University.
[*] All royalty-free music replaced with custom tracks.
[*] Date events removed and replaced with new and extended scenes in Acts 1 and 2. (Route determination altered to fit the new scenes.)
[*] Other tweaks and fixes tied to the above changes.
[/list]
There isn't a set release window for the update yet, but a demo of the prelude will hopefully be made available soon. Promotional and Achievement art has also been updated to prepare for the update.

When the update releases, playing the older versions can be accomplished by opting into the "v1" or "v2"  beta branches. Note that while ending completion should carry over between versions, saves are otherwise not likely to be compatible due to the changes in the structure of the game.

There will be another announcement when the update is closer to completion. Until then, I hope people look forward to it!

notes.title: Beta of Update v2
notes.content:
Since I was already in revision mode from working on the v10 update for Blooming Nightshade, I ended up coming back to Eldritch Academy and taking a look at it. While I would need a significant amount of time and money to address some of the criticisms I've noticed for the game, one thing in particular stood out as something that I could fix without too much trouble: redundant and unnecessary scenes slowing down the pacing of the early game, especially on repeat playthroughs. So over the past few days, I took a look at a number of things in the game and tried to find a way to fix the problems I saw.

The result of the changes I made have reached a point where I may almost have a v2 release ready for the game. However, I've not have time to fully proofread or test this build, so for now I've only put the build on a Beta branch listed as "v2_beta", which should become available soon. (For those who would like to retain the release version of the game, there is a new "Beta" for the game labelled "v1_release". Switching to this build will retain the original version of the game.)

Here's a rundown of what has changed in the current build for v2:
[list]
[*]Several scenes removed from Act 1 and Act 2. Remaining scenes have been modified to reflect the absence of these scenes.
[*]"Partner Choices" removed. All partner choice events have been integrated fully into the common route events.
[*]"Date Choices" overhauled. Dates in Act 1 and Act 2 work the same as in v1. However, the ending scene of Act 2 now locks in the route, similar to the special route version of the event. In paired routes, Act 3 date events are automatic and are with the character whose route is locked in.
[*]Due to the shuffling of events, the date/weekday box has been removed.
[*]Breakup endings have been removed and affection points reworked. In the new system, making too many wrong choices in Act 4 will lead to the Nightmare Ending. (Special route is not affected.)
[*]CG Gallery and Scene Replay have been tweaked to be easier to use.
[*]To reflect the removal of certain scenes, the requirements for the achievement to see all endings have been modified. It now checks for all six endings, all twenty-four date events, and seeing the CG in the Aftermath stories. (The achievement still only checks on starting up the program for now.)
[*]Numerous tweaks to the internal code of certain features.
[/list]

Old save files probably won't work with this build, but the persistent data file should. (It can have a complicated relationship with the way certain scenes changed for "read text" purposes, but the ending flags are the same.)

At any rate, be sure to tell me what you think of the update if you get a chance to try it out. I'd like to find and remove any bugs that may be in the code before I put the build on the main branch of the game, and it would be interesting to hear if the story edits helped with the slow pacing of the early game. I'll eventually get around to testing it myself, but it will be easier to catch issues if someone that doesn't know the code so well takes a look.

At any rate, I hope people continue to enjoy the game. For now, I should return to working on the Blooming Nightshade revisions and working on Eldritch University...

notes.title: Changes to Achievements
notes.content:
Due to some currently behind-the-scenes work, both Blooming Nightshade and Eldritch Academy are getting some changes to their achievement lists. Details are below.

[h1]Blooming Nightshade[/h1]

Thanks to the process leading to v10, a number of the achievements in the Steam release no longer made sense with the planned revisions. While v9 will be available as a "beta" branch for those who want to play it after v10 comes out, I felt the achievements should probably reflect the main version of the game.

Because of this, some achievements were removed (the cheating achievement) or renamed (romance achievements). In addition, a number of achievements related to playing the friendship route of each character have been added. These new achievements cannot be acquired just yet, but hopefully v10 comes soon enough that people can get started on those in the near future.

[h1]Eldritch Academy[/h1]

For reasons I'm not ready to share, the breakup achievements have been removed from the game. In exchange, most of the placeholder art for achievements has been replaced with CG art from the game. It doesn't mean much until the game is allowed to be featured on profiles, but I hope people like the updated achievement art regardless.

tags.feature: In addition, a number of achievements related to playing the friendship route of each character have been added.

notes.title: Release Information Update
notes.content:
The release date for Eldritch Academy on Steam is being narrowed down, with the current plan being for [b][u]March 22nd[/u][/b] (give or take a week in either direction).

As part of its Steam integration, the game has been given a number of achievements for completing certain endings. The current achievement icons may be subject to change.

The game is planned to be released with a price of [b]$11.99 USD[/b], with a 10% launch discount.
